units.source_text: 被沙子打倒，昏厥过去以后，他一直就这么躺着。

en.t: After being knocked down by the sand and losing consciousness, he had simply lain there ever since.

units.source_text: 最初的两天，他被接近三十九度的高烧和持续的呕吐困扰着。

en.t: For the first two days, he was tormented by a high fever close to thirty-nine degrees and by constant vomiting.

units.source_text: 再过一天，烧退了，食欲也恢复了些许。

en.t: After another day, the fever went down, and his appetite recovered a little as well.

units.source_text: 要问究竟怎么会倒下，与其说是沙崩所致，

en.t: If one asked exactly why he had collapsed, it was less because of the sand cave-in

units.source_text: 不如说是由于长时间受阳光直射，不停地干那种还没习惯的体力活造成的。

en.t: than because he had spent long hours in direct sunlight, endlessly doing the kind of physical labor he was not yet used to.

units.source_text: 结果，并没有什么大不了的伤病。

en.t: In the end, there was no serious injury or illness to speak of.
